name: EPIC 201521936
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 12.6 solar radii and 1.11 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201521936 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.577421 (16th-84th percentiles 12.016133-13.301516), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201521936 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.109782 (16th-84th percentiles 0.991844-1.261141), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201521936: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4829.778 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201521936 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 5245.46875 (16th-84th percentiles 5112.109375-5396.171875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.07 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 5,246 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.11 solar masses and 12.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,830 K at its surface.
